answer: A payout is split so that 52% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The zephyr schedule is applied in cipher and whisper shows each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 840 identities would post 1112 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
